item_short_desc: Rothco’s SWAT Belt is designed to be fully customizable and adaptable to your tactical preferences. Featuring 4 removable hook & loop pouches, this uniform belt allows you to modify its layout to suit your needs, whether you require extra space for tactical equipment or prefer a streamlined setup. The adjustable waist belt extends up to 49 inches, making it ideal for various body types. Crafted from 100% polyester, this durable yet lightweight duty belt is built to withstand wear and tear.
description: Rothco’s SWAT Belt is designed to be fully customizable and adaptable to your tactical preferences. Featuring 4 removable hook & loop pouches, this uniform belt allows you to modify its layout to suit your needs, whether you require extra space for tactical equipment or prefer a streamlined setup. The adjustable waist belt extends up to 49 inches, making it ideal for various body types. Crafted from 100% polyester, this durable yet lightweight duty belt is built to withstand wear and tear, ensuring long-lasting use in the field. With a width of 1 7/8 inches, it provides a secure fit without sacrificing comfort. Whether you’re small game hunting, participating in outdoor tournaments, or looking for a tactical-style belt for costumes, Rothco’s SWAT Belt delivers functionality and reliability.
